name: Genie / Genie 3
summary: Genie trains on 200,000+ hours of unlabeled internet gameplay video and infers a discrete latent action space with no action labels whatsoever, yielding a controllable generative environment where each latent action produces a consistent effect. Later generations extended this to real-time, longer-horizon interactive world generation with persistent scene memory.
innovation: Unsupervised latent action discovery from pure video, removing the need for action-labeled data.
Generated environments that are interactive and controllable rather than passive video.
matters: The latent-action trick directly enabled robot models such as GR00T N1 to learn from unlabeled human video.
limits: Closed; physical fidelity is far below what contact-rich manipulation requires. Verify version details.
lineage: World models trained from unlabeled video with self-discovered actions.
